title: Issues mapping any sort of keys to caps lock.

judgment.rationale: The report says mapping to Caps Lock fails validation and is discarded, but it does not state the exact source-to-target mapping or whether Caps Lock is intended as the source or destination in the shown setup. That direction is necessary to reproduce the editor validation failure.
evidence: The body reports PowerToys 0.77.0 and says the 'To Send' section is reported empty despite a configured value.
The title and expected behavior mention mapping keys to Caps Lock, but the text does not give the exact mapping tuple or shortcut target.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact source and target shown in the editor and whether the failing action is Save or OK; do not request generic diagnostics.

fix_assessment.rationale: The source/target direction and validation step are not sufficiently specified to identify an applicable code fix. Current engine code contains a Caps Lock-specific reset path, which does not by itself prove that the reported editor save behavior is handled.

issue_context.summary: A Keyboard Manager remap involving Caps Lock reportedly fails a required-target validation check and is discarded, but the exact mapping direction is unclear.
known_information: The report used PowerToys 0.77.0 installed with WinGet and says it was run as administrator.
The reporter says the 'To Send' section complains that nothing is set and the binding disappears after pressing OK.
No public comments or additional reproduction details are present.
inferences: The issue may be an editor validation or serialization defect, but it is not possible to tell whether Caps Lock is configured as the source or the destination.
The current engine has Caps Lock-specific handling for modifier state; that is not evidence that the older editor failure is resolved.
issue_context.analysis: A single exact mapping and the action that discards it are enough to test the current editor. Asking for logs would not resolve the missing mapping semantics.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body and confirmed there are no comments.

Checked current Keyboard Manager handling in src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEngineLibrary/KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp; the VK_CAPITAL special case concerns modifier state and does not establish editor validation behavior.

information_gaps.information: The exact source key/shortcut and target, whether Caps Lock is the source or destination, and the step that makes the row disappear.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a direction-specific editor validation error from a target-key runtime limitation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please list the mapping exactly as shown in each editor column and state whether it disappears immediately, on pressing OK, or after reopening Keyboard Manager.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same mapping still fails on the current supported PowerToys version.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report uses version 0.77.0; a current build determines whether the validation behavior remains.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please include the version shown in PowerToys Settings > About with the reproduction.

comment.body:
Thanks for noting that the editor reports the 'To Send' section as empty and discards the binding after you press OK. The report does not show which source key/shortcut maps to Caps Lock, or whether Caps Lock is the source instead. Please provide:
- The exact source and target displayed in each column.
- Whether the row disappears immediately or only after pressing OK/reopening Keyboard Manager.
- Whether it still happens on the current version shown in Settings > About.
This will let maintainers reproduce the specific editor validation path without requesting unrelated logs.
